description: JWT signing secret is passed to PyJWT jwt.encode as a string or bytes literal. Six scenarios cover positional string, default-looking string, keyword key= string, module alias, direct function import and bytes literal.

findings.context: jwt.encode with positional string literal secret
jwt.encode with default-looking positional string literal
jwt.encode with keyword key= string literal
j.encode through import jwt as j with string literal
encode through from jwt import encode with string literal
encode alias with bytes literal secret
